name: HK-47 Carbine
description: The HK-47 Carbine, also known as HK-47 blaster, was a custom-crafted model of blaster carbine was developed during the final years of the Galactic Republic. It was unusual in that it was equipped with a bio-link module that allowed the user to interface directly with the weapon during combat. One such weapon was owned by the droid HK-47 during the Galactic Civil War.
